newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong says HK home prices have stabilised.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong says HK home prices have stabilised.

text.p: Victor Li, vice chairman of Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd, said on Monday Hong Kong's residential property prices have stablised after a recent correction.

"I believe property prices have largely been stabilised, especially for the good quality ones, such as big housing estates," Li told reporters after he attended an annual general meeting of Hong Kong Electric Holdings Ltd.
Li is also an executive director of Hong Kong Electric.
"As (we) heard from Hong Kong Property Service, transactions are increasing gradually," he added.
Hong Kong Property Services (Agency) Co Ltd is a property agency formed in the late 1996 by property developer Cheung Kong and LandPower International Property Agency Ltd.
"For end users, it is the right time to take a look (at the market)," Li said.
Property prices tumbled about 10 percent in April after the government announced measures to curb speculation.
